newsitem.title: USA: Collins closes $310 mln Mastercraft sale.
newsitem.headline: Collins closes $310 mln Mastercraft sale.

text.p: Collins & Aikman Corp said Wednesday it closed the sale of its Mastercraft Group to private Joan Fabrics Corp for about $310 million.
Collins said it will use the sale's net proceeds, about $280 million, to reduce its long-term debt.
Chief executive Thomas Hannah said the group's sale would increase the company's financial flexibility and focus it on its core car interior systems business.
The Mastercraft Group, a manufacturer of flat-woven upholstery fabrics, posted revenues of about $264 million for the 11 months ended December 28, 1996, Collins said.
The company first said it was considering selling the Mastercraft Group late last year.

Collins on July 1 said it agreed to sell another unit, its air restraint and technical products division, to Safety Components International Inc for $56.3 million in cash. Like now, it said it intended to use the proceeds to reduce long-term debt.

The company posted a net income of $97.4 million on revenues of $432.3 million in the first quarter, compared with a $136.4 million net on revenues of $257.7 million the year before. Its stock traded at 11-3/8 Wednesday afternoon, down 1/16.
